segments.text: This apprehending of Christ is not done by any corporall touching of him, but spiritually by assurāce, which is, whē the elect are perswaded in their hearts by the holy ghost, of the forgiueuesse of their owne sinnes, and of gods infinit mercie towards them in Iesus Christ. According to that of Paul. Now we haue receiued, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is of God, that wee might know the things which are giuen vs of God. The things which the spirit of God maketh known to the faithfull particularly, are their iustification, adoption, sanctification, eternall life: and thus when any are perswaded of these things concerning themselues, they doe in their hearts distinctly apply and appropriate Christ and his benefits to themselues.
